text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks for the meal.
When it comes to efficient energy replenishment, nothing beats bananas.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, look! Banana-senpai is here~
She was eating a banana again~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"B-Banana-senpai...?
Wait, you don't mean me—"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! It's Banana-senpai!
Heyyy, Banana-senpaaaai~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! I am not your upperclassman!
Besides...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What is this... Banana-senpai thing anyway...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —...Or so I dreamed.
choice_data_list: You like it so much you're even having dreams about it...
You must really love it if you're dreaming about it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! It's true that I eat a lot,
but it's not for simplistic reasons like liking or disliking food!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Bananas are rich in nutrients that fuel the brain, highly portable, and their sweetness relieves fatigue!
In other words, my appreciation for that fruit is purely logical—

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer
text_block_list.text:
Step right up~! Big banana sale today!
Eat up till your tummy's full~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-Banana...!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Can I not... escape it...?
From the temptation... of this banana!
choice_data_list: Your brain must be craving bananas too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Can I not... escape it...?
From the temptation... of this banana!
choice_data_list: Your brain must be craving bananas too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, what on earth even is Banana-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you.
I almost gave in to temptation there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, let us leave this place at once.
We cannot allow this to become a prophetic dream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I-I see!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This rumble in my belly isn't a craving saying 'I want to eat a banana'...
It's a signal sent from my brain!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, I must eat... until my brain is satisfied!

Afterward, she ate with magnificent gusto.
Her majestic presence made me almost want to call her... 'Banana-senpai.'
